note: Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web for Pushmataha County and its towns (Antlers, Clayton, Rattan). The county's only queryable ArcGIS service holds census, legislative, transportation and hydrology layers, with no zoning. Antlers has a zoning code in its ordinances but publishes no zoning district map or service; its code office directs map requests to a staff contact. No zoning polygon layer was found for the county or its towns.
